fact: The Cabinet's second follow-up report on the National Dialogue plan states MCIT had run digital capacity-building programmes for leaders and staff in the governorates totalling 26,000 employees, and had trained 2,060 staff of the governorates' information systems and digital transformation units.
title: رئيس الوزراء يستعرض تقرير المتابعة الثاني للخطة التنفيذية للإجراءات المُقترحة من الحوار الوطني
